profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap point in Sarzana, Italy, tagged telecom=data_center, is named "ACI Sede si Sarzana." The Italian word "sede" means office or headquarters, and ACI most plausibly refers to Automobile Club d'Italia, the country's national automobile association, which operates local branch offices throughout Italy providing vehicle registration, roadside assistance coordination, and member services. A local branch office of this kind maintains its own administrative IT systems but is not a data center in any commercial or enterprise-infrastructure sense. The telecom=data_center tag is best explained as a mistag of the office's telecom or IT closet rather than an indication that ACI operates a data-center business at this address.
